name: Spaghetti pomodoro
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil for the spaghetti.
Peel and thinly slice the garlic cloves.
Warm the olive oil in a wide pan over low heat and fry the garlic for 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant but not brown.
Add the canned tomatoes, crush them with a spoon, season with salt and pepper and simmer for 15 minutes until thickened.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in the boiling water until al dente, about 9 minutes, and keep a cup of the pasta water.
Drain the spaghetti and toss it in the sauce over medium heat for 1 minute, adding a splash of pasta water if it looks dry.
Tear the basil leaves into the pasta, grate the parmesan over it and serve straight away.

name: Spaghetti carbonara
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil for the spaghetti.
Cut the guanciale into small strips.
Finely grate the pecorino and whisk it with the eggs and plenty of black pepper in a bowl.
Fry the guanciale in a dry pan over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes until crisp and the fat has melted, then take the pan off the heat.
Cook the spaghetti until al dente, about 9 minutes, and keep a cup of the pasta water before draining.
Add the spaghetti to the guanciale and toss well so it is coated in the fat.
With the pan off the heat, pour in the egg mixture and toss quickly, adding pasta water a little at a time until the sauce is creamy, not scrambled.
Serve at once with more black pepper.

name: Pesto pasta with cherry tomatoes
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil for the penne.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes until golden, then set them aside.
Halve the cherry tomatoes.
Cook the penne until al dente, about 11 minutes, and keep a cup of the pasta water before draining.
Warm the olive oil in the pan over medium heat and fry the cherry tomatoes for 2 minutes until they just soften.
Add the penne and the pesto with a splash of pasta water and toss until glossy.
Serve sprinkled with the pine nuts and grated parmesan.

name: Beef burgers with oven fries
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Cut the potatoes into 1 cm thick fries, toss them with the olive oil, paprika and salt and spread them out on the tray.
Bake the fries for 35 to 40 minutes, turning them halfway, until golden and crisp.
Meanwhile, slice the tomatoes and red onion, separate the lettuce leaves and slice the cheddar.
Shape the ground beef into 4 patties slightly wider than the burger buns and season them with salt and pepper.
Fry the patties in a hot pan over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, laying the cheddar on top after turning them.
Toast the cut sides of the burger buns in the pan for 1 minute.
Spread ketchup on the buns and build the burgers with lettuce, tomato, the patties and red onion, then serve with the fries.

name: Chicken curry with rice
steps: Finely chop the onions and garlic cloves and grate the ginger.
Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat and fry the onions for 8 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken and fry for 5 minutes, turning it, until sealed all over.
Pour in the canned tomatoes and coconut milk, season with salt and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Meanwhile, rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of salted water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Serve the curry over the rice.

name: Teriyaki chicken with rice
steps: Rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Stir the soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar together until the sugar dissolves.
Pat the chicken thighs dry and slice the spring onions.
Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the chicken thighs for 6 to 8 minutes until golden, then turn and fry for 4 minutes more.
Wipe out the excess fat, pour in the sauce and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, turning the chicken, until the sauce is thick and glossy and the chicken is cooked through.
Slice the chicken, lay it on the rice and spoon the sauce over it.
Sprinkle with the spring onions and sesame seeds and serve.

name: Chicken fajitas
steps: Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and crush the garlic cloves.
Mix the chicken with the garlic, cumin, paprika, chili powder, the juice of the lime, 1 tbsp of the vegetable oil and salt.
Leave the chicken to marinate for 15 minutes.
Slice the bell peppers and red onion into thin strips.
Heat the rest of the vegetable oil in a large pan over high heat and fry the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until browned and cooked through, then set it aside.
Fry the bell peppers and red onion in the same pan over high heat for 5 minutes until soft and charred at the edges.
Return the chicken to the pan and toss everything together.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill the tortillas with the chicken and vegetables, top with sour cream, roll them up and serve.

name: Chicken Caesar salad
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Cut the bread into 2 cm cubes, toss them with 2 tbsp of the olive oil and bake for 8 to 10 minutes until golden and crisp.
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper and fry it in 1 tbsp of the olive oil over medium heat for 6 to 7 minutes per side until cooked through, then let it rest for 5 minutes.
Boil the egg for 1 minute, cool it under cold water and spoon the soft egg into a bowl.
Mash the anchovy fillets and crushed garlic clove into the egg, then whisk in the worcestershire sauce, the juice of the lemon and the rest of the olive oil in a thin stream.
Grate the parmesan, stir half of it into the dressing and season with pepper.
Tear the romaine lettuce into pieces and toss it with the dressing.
Slice the chicken and serve it on the salad with the croutons and the rest of the parmesan.

name: Oven-baked salmon with potatoes and green beans
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Cut the potatoes into 3 cm pieces and toss them on a baking tray with half of the olive oil, the crushed garlic cloves, salt and pepper.
Roast the potatoes for 20 minutes.
Trim the green beans and slice one lemon.
Push the potatoes to the sides, add the green beans and the salmon, drizzle with the rest of the olive oil, season and lay the lemon slices on the salmon.
Roast for 12 to 15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily and the potatoes are golden.
Squeeze the juice of the second lemon over everything, scatter the chopped dill on top and serve.

name: Fish tacos
steps: Finely shred the red cabbage and mix it with the juice of one lime and a pinch of salt.
Cut the cod into strips and season it with the cumin, paprika, salt and pepper.
Halve and stone the avocados and slice the flesh.
Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium-high heat and fry the cod for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill the tortillas with the red cabbage, cod and avocado.
Top with sour cream and chopped coriander and serve with the second lime cut into wedges.

name: Chickpea and spinach curry
steps: Rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of salted water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Finely chop the onion and garlic cloves and grate the ginger.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat and fry the onion for 8 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Drain and rinse the canned chickpeas and add them with the canned tomatoes and coconut milk, then season with salt.
Simmer for 15 minutes until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted, then serve the curry over the rice.

name: Vegetable stir-fry with noodles
steps: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water for 4 minutes, then drain and rinse them under cold water.
Slice the bell pepper and carrot into thin strips, halve the snow peas and slice the spring onions.
Finely chop the garlic cloves and grate the ginger.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the carrot for 2 minutes.
Add the bell pepper and snow peas and stir-fry for 2 minutes more.
Add the garlic, ginger and spring onions and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the egg noodles and soy sauce and toss for 2 minutes until hot.
Take the wok off the heat, drizzle with the sesame oil and serve.

name: Shakshuka with bread
steps: Finely chop the onion and garlic cloves, and cut the bell pepper into strips.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan and fry the onion and bell pepper over medium heat for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the canned tomatoes, season with salt and pepper and simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Make 4 hollows in the sauce with a spoon and crack an egg into each one.
Cover the pan and cook over low heat for 6 to 8 minutes until the egg whites are set but the yolks are still runny.
Crumble the feta over the top.
Slice the bread and serve it with the shakshuka for dipping.

name: Couscous salad with halloumi
steps: Bring the vegetable stock to the boil, pour it over the couscous in a bowl, cover and leave it for 5 minutes.
Fluff up the couscous with a fork and let it cool.
Dice the cucumber, halve the cherry tomatoes and finely chop the red onion.
Finely chop the parsley and mint.
Whisk the juice of the lemon with 3 tbsp of the olive oil, salt and pepper.
Mix the couscous with the cucumber, cherry tomatoes, red onion, parsley, mint and dressing.
Slice the halloumi and fry it in the remaining olive oil over medium-high heat for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Serve the salad topped with the warm halloumi.

name: Greek salad with feta and bread
steps: Cut the tomatoes into wedges and the cucumber into thick half-moons.
Slice the bell pepper into rings and the red onion into thin half-rings.
Put the vegetables in a bowl with the olives and season with salt.
Lay the feta on top as one slab and sprinkle it with the oregano.
Drizzle the olive oil over the salad.
Slice the bread and serve it with the salad to mop up the juices.

name: Penne arrabbiata
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Thinly slice the garlic cloves and chop the parsley.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over low heat and fry the garlic and chili flakes for 2 minutes without letting the garlic brown.
Add the canned tomatoes, season with salt and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Meanwhile cook the penne in the boiling water until al dente, about 11 minutes.
Drain the penne, toss it in the sauce over the heat for 1 minute and stir in the parsley.

name: Spaghetti aglio e olio
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Cook the spaghetti until al dente, about 9 minutes.
Meanwhile thinly slice the garlic cloves and finely chop the parsley.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over low heat and fry the garlic and chili flakes for 3 to 4 minutes until the garlic turns pale golden.
Scoop out a cup of the pasta water, then drain the spaghetti.
Add the spaghetti and a splash of the pasta water to the pan and toss over medium heat for 1 minute until the sauce turns glossy.
Stir in the parsley, season with salt and serve.

name: Mac and cheese
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Cook the macaroni in salted water for 2 minutes less than the packet says, then drain it.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring, until the sauce thickens.
Grate the cheddar, take the pan off the heat and stir in two thirds of it, then season with salt and pepper.
Mix the macaroni with the sauce and spread it in a baking dish.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the rest of the cheddar and the paprika and scatter them over the top.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

name: Gnocchi with tomato sauce and mozzarella
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C and bring a large pot of salted water to the boil.
Chop the garlic cloves and fry them in the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add the canned tomatoes, season with salt and pepper and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Tear half the basil into the sauce.
Cook the gnocchi in the boiling water until they float to the surface, then drain them.
Mix the gnocchi with the sauce and spread them in a baking dish.
Tear the mozzarella over the top and sprinkle with the grated parmesan.
Bake for 10 to 15 minutes until the mozzarella has melted and is bubbling.
Scatter the rest of the basil over the top and serve.

name: Beef stroganoff with rice
steps: Rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of salted water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile cut the beef sirloin into thin strips and slice the onion and mushrooms.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over high heat and sear the beef sirloin strips in batches for 1 to 2 minutes until browned, then set them aside.
Lower the heat to medium, melt the butter in the pan and fry the onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the mushrooms and fry for 5 minutes until golden, then stir in the paprika.
Pour in the beef stock, stir in the mustard and simmer for 5 minutes until slightly reduced.
Lower the heat, stir in the sour cream and return the meat with its juices, then heat through gently for 2 minutes without boiling.
Season with salt and pepper, sprinkle with the chopped parsley and serve with the rice.

name: Bratwurst with sauerkraut and mashed potatoes
steps: Peel the potatoes, cut them into even chunks and boil them in salted water for 20 minutes until soft.
Meanwhile, heat half of the vegetable oil in a pot and fry the chopped onion over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the sauerkraut, bay leaf, caraway and a splash of water, then cover and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Heat the rest of the vegetable oil in a frying pan and fry the bratwurst over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes, turning them until browned on all sides.
Warm the milk with the butter in a small pan until the butter melts.
Drain the potatoes, mash them and beat in the hot milk until smooth, then season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Remove the bay leaf from the sauerkraut and serve it with the bratwurst, the mashed potatoes and mustard on the side.

name: Chicken quesadillas
steps: Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and season it with the cumin, chili powder and salt.
Heat the vegetable oil in a frying pan and fry the chicken over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Add the sliced bell pepper and red onion and fry for 3 minutes more, then tip everything onto a plate and wipe out the pan.
Sprinkle half of each tortilla with half of the grated cheddar.
Spread the chicken mixture and chopped coriander over the cheddar and cover them with the rest of the cheddar.
Fold each tortilla over the filling.
Cook the quesadillas in the dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheddar has melted.
Cut them into wedges and serve with sour cream.

name: Pad thai with chicken
steps: Soak the rice noodles in warm water for 20 to 30 minutes until soft but still firm, then drain.
Stir the tamarind paste, fish sauce, sugar and chili flakes together until the sugar dissolves.
Roughly chop the peanuts, slice the spring onions and cut the lime into wedges.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the thinly sliced chicken breast for 3 to 4 minutes, adding the minced garlic cloves for the last 30 seconds.
Push the chicken to the side, crack the eggs into the wok and scramble them for 1 minute.
Add the drained noodles and the sauce and toss for 2 to 3 minutes until the noodles have soaked up the sauce.
Toss in the bean sprouts and spring onions for 30 seconds.
Serve sprinkled with the peanuts, with the lime wedges on the side.

name: Tuna pasta bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Cook the penne in salted boiling water for 2 minutes less than the packet says, then drain.
Melt the butter in a pan, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring, until the sauce thickens.
Take the sauce off the heat and stir in half of the grated cheddar, salt and pepper.
Mix the penne with the sauce, the drained canned tuna and the drained canned sweetcorn and spread it in a baking dish.
Sprinkle with the rest of the cheddar and bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

name: Thai green curry with prawns
steps: Rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Tear each makrut lime leaf in half.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok and fry the green curry paste over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add a third of the coconut milk and cook for 3 minutes until the oil starts to separate.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, the fish sauce, the sugar and the torn leaves, and bring to a simmer.
Add the eggplant, cut into chunks, and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the green beans, cut into short lengths, and simmer for 4 minutes.
Add the prawns and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until they are pink and cooked through.
Stir in the thai basil leaves and serve the curry with the rice.

name: Bean burritos
steps: Rinse the rice and bring it to the boil in 1.5 times its volume of salted water.
Cover, simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, then leave it to stand off the heat for 5 minutes.
Heat the vegetable oil in a pan and fry the chopped onion over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the minced garlic cloves, cumin and chili powder and fry for 1 minute.
Add the drained canned pinto beans with a splash of water, roughly mash them and simmer for 5 minutes, then season with salt.
Dice the tomatoes and mix them with chopped coriander, the juice of the lime and salt.
Warm each tortilla in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill the tortillas with rice, beans, grated cheddar, the tomato salsa and sour cream, fold in the sides and roll them up.

name: Potato goulash
steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot and fry the chopped onions over medium heat for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the minced garlic cloves and the tomato paste and fry for 1 minute.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the paprika so it doesn't burn.
Put the pot back on the heat, add the peeled, cubed potatoes, the caraway, the marjoram, the bay leaf and the beef stock and bring to the boil.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the potatoes are soft and some have broken down to thicken the goulash.
Add the sliced frankfurters and heat them through for 5 minutes.
Remove the bay leaf, season with salt and pepper and serve.

name: Sweet potato and black bean chili
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot and fry the chopped onion and bell pepper over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic cloves, chili powder, cumin and paprika and fry for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the peeled sweet potatoes cut into 2 cm cubes, the canned tomatoes and the vegetable stock, then cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the drained canned black beans and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes until the sweet potatoes are tender and the chili has thickened.
Stir in the juice of the lime, season with salt and serve sprinkled with chopped coriander.

name: Niçoise salad
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes until tender, then drain and halve them.
Cook the green beans in boiling salted water for 4 minutes, then cool them in cold water.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool them in cold water, then peel and quarter them.
Whisk the olive oil with the white wine vinegar, salt and pepper.
Arrange the lettuce leaves on plates with the potatoes, green beans and tomatoes cut into wedges.
Top with the drained canned tuna, the eggs, the olives and the anchovy fillets.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and serve.
